correctness.rationale: For \(s\not\equiv2\pmod4\), the order-five subgroup yields the explicit polynomial \(X^t(1+X^r+\cdots+X^{4r})\), which vanishes at \(\beta\) and \(\beta^3\); its \(r=n/5\) supports partition the coordinates. For \(s\equiv2\pmod4\), the source's exact order-fifty-one pattern lifts to \(r=n/51\) translates whose supports are distinct residue classes modulo \(r\). Thus the generators are independent and disjoint, and every sum has weight five times the number selected. This proves the direct-sum repetition structure, exact subcode enumerator, coefficientwise ambient lower bounds, and generalized-weight inequalities. The two finite-field root patterns are independently reconstructed in the bundled verifier.

value.rationale: The recent paper resolves only the first generalized Hamming weight \(d_1=5\). The new structure is macroscopic: it exposes \(n/5\) or \(n/51\) independent minimum words, an exact exponentially large subcode spectrum, and an initial generalized-Hamming upper profile of length \(r_s\). These are natural invariants of the same BCH family and materially refine one-word minimum-distance existence rather than merely producing another isolated codeword.
